newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stable amid ample liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stable amid ample liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in thin trading on Thursday, dealers said.
They said operators were mainly staying on the sidelines despite ample rupiah supply in the money market.
"Operators are reluctant to take the initiative because of the approaching year-end," one local bank dealer said, adding that operators would remained sidelined until Monday.
"They don't want to be exposed because they can't square positions in such a thin market," he said.
The foreign exchange market will be closed on December 31 and January 1. It will reopen on January 2.
Another dealer said speculation for a band widening seemed to be in some operators' minds as well because the central bank had widened its band late in December last year.
"Speculation for the band remains, which may explain the reluctance in the market to buy dollars despite flush rupiah supply," the dealer said.
However, dealers said speculation for a band widening was secondary, with year-end factors still seen the main issue.
Many operators said another band widening in the last two trading days was unlikely following the central bank's steady depreciation of the rupiah in recent weeks.
One Japanese bank dealer said short-term dollar deposit rates were seen edging up on increased demand.
"It may be due to the usual high year-end demand for travel purposes or corporate transfers of profits," the dealer said.
Overnight dollar deposit rate was relatively stable at 5.50/5.75 percent, but one- and two-week rates inched up to around seven percent.
The local bank dealer said operators seemed to shrug off the fact that dollar interest rates were edging up while the rupiah rate was declining.
"There is no reflection in the dollar-rupiah trading."
Swap rates fell across the board following ample liquidity.
Overnight swap was at 0.10/0.15 and tom/next at 0.65/0.75.
One-month swaps was at 13.5/14.0, two at 27.50/29.50, three at 39.5/41.0 and six at 84.00/85.00 points.
The dollar-rupiah rate was trading in a narrow-range band, with the rate expected to remain the same for the rest of the day, dealers said.
Spot rupiah was at 2,362.25/62.75 at 0330 GMT against an opening of 2,362.0/63.0. Tomorrow and today rupiah were quoted at 2,361.60/62.25 and 2,361.5/62.0, respectively.
The central bank's intervention rate on Tuesday was 2,357/2,549 and the conversion rate was 2,357/2,405.
